text.tspan: Countries that are democracies and autocracies World
Classification by Lührmann et al. (2018) based on expert estimates by V-Dem.

tspan.tspan: The share of closed autocracies increases a lot in 1900 because V-Dem covers many more countries since then, often colonies.
